liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Wharf Rat** (1 review): Listener calls this version a personal favorite, praising Brent's keyboard performance [16]
- **Minglewood Blues** (1 review): Listener identifies this as one of their favorite Minglewood Blues performances [21]

## The recordings

- **gd85-06-24.sbd.miller.25315.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 22 songs; 154 min; rated 4.48/5 by 69 [1]. Said about its sound: Listener praises the pristine sonic clarity of this SBD recording [25]
- **gd1985-06-24.sbd.harrell.8198.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 153 min; rated 5/5 by 4 [2]
- **gd85-06-24.sbd.murphy.2274.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 156 min; rated 4.25/5 by 16 [3]. Said about its sound: Listener notes clarity and separation, highlighting Brent's keys and Jerry's rough voice; SBD has Healy effects, but pillows cover cymbals and Phil; AUD sounds better [16][22]
- **gd1985-06-24.mtx.seamons.94663.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 154 min; rated 4.29/5 by 7 [4]
- **gd1985-06-24.mtx.pytlik.32310.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 154 min; rated 3.83/5 by 12 [5]
- **gd85-06-24.nak300.lai.360.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 20 songs; 144 min; rated 4.15/5 by 13 [12]. Said about its sound: Nak300 recording offers good full-range outdoor amphitheatre sound, unlike the muffled SBD; Audio source is good except for glitching in U.S. Blues, suggesting skipping the encore; Listener finds the recording quality poor and the band, especially Garcia, sounds sloppy [17][20][23]

## Around the show

- Listener notes the show took place in their hometown [19]
- Rain made the lawn slippery; attendance record of 9,000 set at Riverbend [21]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd85-06-24.sbd.miller.25315.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > Cassette Master > PCM > DAT > CD [1]. Also: Charlie Miller transferred and edited the SBD via cassette, PCM, DAT, and CD [1]
- **gd1985-06-24.sbd.harrell.8198.shnf**: transferred by Bob Harrell; source: SBD > Master Cassette [2]. Also: Fixed by Patrick Murphy; brief static at Let It Grow, tape flip in set 2 [2]
- **gd85-06-24.sbd.murphy.2274.sbefail.shnf**: source: SBD -> CM -> PCM -> DAT, via Pete Delgado [3]
- **gd1985-06-24.mtx.seamons.94663.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [4]. Also: Charlie Miller transferred SBD; Doug Oade transferred Nak 300 audience source [4]
- **gd1985-06-24.mtx.pytlik.32310.sbeok.flac16**: taped by See info file; transferred by Matrixing by Timothy Pytlik; source: See info file [5]. Also: Pytlik notes audience source left channel dropouts in U.S. Blues were repaired; Spectral analysis suggests the second set SBD source is a VHS master [5]
- **gd85-06-24.nak300.lai.360.sbeok.shnf**: source: Nak 300 > D5 > CM > CDR [12]
